question: The indigenous CAR‑T therapy has shown maximum efficacy against B‑ALL and which other blood cancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Non‑Hodgkin Lymphoma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• CAR-T therapy (Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-cell therapy) is an advanced form of immunotherapy where T-cells are genetically engineered to attack specific cancer cells.
 
• The indigenous CAR-T therapy developed in India has shown maximum efficacy in treating B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (B-ALL) and Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma (NHL).
 
• Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma is a diverse group of blood cancers that originate in the lymphatic system, often characterized by the uncontrolled growth of lymphocytes.
 
• Clinical trials have demonstrated significant success rates of CAR-T therapy in relapsed or refractory cases of Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma and B-ALL.
 
• The therapy is a critical breakthrough, offering hope to patients who do not respond to conventional treatments like chemotherapy or radiation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma (NHL):**

 
 
• NHL includes various subtypes, such as Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL) and Follicular Lymphoma.
 
• It is often associated with symptoms like swollen lymph nodes, fever, night sweats, and weight loss.
 
• Risk factors for NHL include weakened immune systems, certain infections (e.g., HIV, Epstein-Barr virus), and exposure to chemicals.
 
 
 
• **CAR-T Therapy Mechanism:**
 
 
• In CAR-T therapy, a patient’s T-cells are harvested, genetically modified to express chimeric antigen receptors, and reinfused into the patient.
 
• The modified T-cells target and destroy cancer cells expressing specific antigens, such as CD19 in B-ALL and NHL.
 
 
 
• **Advantages of CAR-T Therapy:**
 
 
• Highly effective in treating relapsed or refractory hematological malignancies.
 
• Provides a personalized approach to cancer treatment with durable remissions in many cases.
 
 
 
• **Challenges and Limitations:**
 
 
• CAR-T therapy is expensive and requires specialized infrastructure for production and administration.
 
• Potential side effects include cytokine release syndrome (CRS) and neurotoxicity, which require careful management.
 
 
 
• **Indigenous Development in India:**
 
 
• The development of indigenous CAR-T therapy in India is significant for reducing costs and improving accessibility for patients.
 
• It represents a milestone in the country’s efforts to advance cancer treatment and biotechnology.
